title: L-DEP-PD-1 LA-HLH analysis code
description: Analysis code for the 24-patient EBV-positive LA-HLH phase 2 study NCT05775705. Release v1.1 uses the supplied 126-variable patient-level CSV and includes baseline/response, EBV-DNA, laboratory, survival, histological subgroup and adverse-event analyses. Code: MIT. Included data and reference outputs: CC BY 4.0. Matching dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24200366. Original dataset DOI remains https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22833596.
